name: Cosine
tagline: 1 minus channel-wise cosine similarity between predicted and target latent maps — angular-only objective.
diff_from_baseline: Standard angular distance loss used in many SSL/JEPA variants (e.g., BYOL, DINO). Ignores magnitude — only direction in representation space matters.

name: MSE
tagline: Plain mean-squared error between predicted and target latent tensors — equivalent to JEPA's default SquareLossSeq.
diff_from_baseline: Default JEPA-family prediction loss (Assran et al., CVPR 2023 — I-JEPA). Pointwise L2 in representation space without projector or whitening.

name: Smooth L1
tagline: Huber-style robust pointwise loss: quadratic for small residuals, linear for large ones.
diff_from_baseline: Huber, Annals of Math. Stat. 1964 — Smooth L1 / Huber loss. Less sensitive to outliers than MSE while remaining differentiable; commonly used as a robust regression baseline.
